ideas.title: MicroSplit
ideas.description:
MicroSplit is a streamlined mobile application designed for friends, roommates, and small teams who want to manage shared expenses without the complexity of traditional accounting software.

Unlike broad expense trackers, MicroSplit focuses on instant settlement. It uses a "single-tap" interface to capture receipts, automatically categorize costs (like groceries, utilities, or dining), and calculate exactly who owes what in real-time.

ideas.title: EduSync AI
ideas.description: EduSync AI is an advanced learning management and orchestration platform designed specifically for the blended learning era of 2026. While traditional EdTech focuses on content delivery, EduSync focuses on interoperability—connecting a student's fragmented learning data from various AI tutors, classroom apps, and digital textbooks into a single, unified "Knowledge Graph."

ideas.title: SkillStreamer
ideas.description: SkillStreamer is a "micro-learning" platform designed for the 2026 workforce, focusing on just-in-time skill acquisition. Instead of long, multi-week courses, it breaks down complex technical and soft skills into "Streams"—highly interactive, 5-to-10 minute modules that can be consumed during a commute or a lunch break.

risks: The monetization path is still vague, which makes it harder to prioritize features and unit economics.
The space already has visible players like Xseed Education, so differentiation has to be sharper than convenience alone.
initialProblems: Finding the first 10-15 early adopters who will test the product repeatedly and give blunt feedback.
Reducing the MVP to one high-friction education and career progress workflow instead of shipping a broad feature list.
advice: Start with a narrow segment of early adopters and position the product around one painful moment in education and career progress.
Make the first release optimize for platform simplicity rather than a long feature checklist.
Test a pricing hypothesis early so the business model is validated alongside product demand.
Differentiate clearly from Xseed Education through a niche audience, faster setup, or a stronger outcome promise.
analysis.summary: The idea addresses education and career progress with a plausible angle, but execution quality and early user focus will decide whether it stands out.
